faqPage.metaDesc: Frequently asked questions about our platform — pricing, features, security, and support for travel agencies and tour operators.
faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subA: Everything you need to know about our platform. Can't find what you're looking for?
faqPage.stillDesc: Our team is happy to help. Book a personalized demo or send us a message.

items.g1q: What is Travel Agency Website & Software Solution?
items.g1a: It is a complete travel agency management platform. It helps you manage leads, create quotations, confirm bookings, generate invoices, track payments, handle vendors, and run reports — all in one place. It's built specifically for travel agencies and tour operators.
items.g2q: Who is this platform designed for?
items.g2a: It's designed for travel agencies, tour operators, Hajj/Umrah service providers, and any business that handles travel bookings. Whether you're a single-person agency or a team of 50+, the platform scales with your needs.
items.g3q: Can I use this for Hajj and Umrah services?
items.g3a: Yes. We have a dedicated Hajj/Umrah module that handles pilgrim registration, package creation with hotel class and transport, room allocation, family grouping, mahram tracking, installment plans, and departure management.
items.g4q: Do I need any technical knowledge to use this?
items.g4a: No. Our platform is designed for travel professionals, not developers. The interface is straightforward — if you can use Facebook or WhatsApp, you can use our platform.
items.p1a: Four plans: Basic (৳500/mo, 500 clients & bookings), Pro (৳800/mo, 1,000 clients & bookings + website + SMS/Email), Business (৳1,500/mo, 2,000 clients & bookings + advanced features), and Unlimited (custom pricing, all features + full automation).
items.p2q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
items.p2a: Absolutely. You can upgrade at any time and the change takes effect immediately. Downgrading is also possible at the end of your billing cycle. Your data is always preserved.
items.p3q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.p3a: We accept bank transfer, bKash, and SSLCommerz for subscription payments. For Unlimited plans, we can arrange custom billing.
items.f1q: Can I create and send quotations to clients?
items.f1a: Yes. The quotation builder lets you add multiple items with pricing, apply discounts, and generate professional PDF quotations. You can track their status (Draft, Sent, Approved, Rejected, Expired) and convert approved quotes directly into bookings.
items.f2q: How does the booking management work?
items.f2a: Bookings support multiple types: tours, flights, hotels, visas, and transport. Each booking can have travelers with passport details, vendor assignments, document uploads, an operations checklist, and a full event timeline. You can also track payment status per booking.
items.f3q: Can I manage vendor costs and track profitability?
items.f3a: Yes. You can assign vendor costs to bookings, track vendor bills (Unpaid, Partial, Paid, Overdue), and see booking-level profitability showing selling price minus vendor cost for gross profit margins.
items.f4a: Reports include: sales analytics, lead-to-booking conversion, payment collection vs outstanding, vendor payable summaries, staff performance comparisons, and booking-level profitability. All reports support date range filters and CSV export.
items.f5q: Can I control what my team members can access?
items.f5a: Yes. Role-based access control lets you define permissions per module (create, edit, delete, approve, export). Built-in roles include Owner, Manager, Accountant, Sales Agent, and Operations staff. You can also create custom roles.
items.s1a: Yes. Each agency gets a completely isolated workspace. Your data is never shared with other agencies. We use encrypted connections, secure authentication, and regular backups.
items.s2a: Yes. Most reports and tables support CSV export. You can also export client lists, booking data, and financial records at any time.
items.s3a: Your data is stored on secure servers. We follow industry-standard practices for data protection and privacy. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
items.sup1a: Free plan users get community support. Basic and Pro plans include email support with 24-hour response times. Business and Enterprise plans get priority support with faster response and dedicated contacts.
items.sup2a: Yes. All paid plans include basic onboarding guidance. Enterprise plans get a dedicated onboarding manager who helps with data migration, team training, and custom setup.
items.sup3q: Can I request a new feature?
items.sup3a: Absolutely. We actively listen to our users. You can submit feature requests through our support channel. Many current features were built based on travel agency feedback.

p: Travel Agency Website & Software Solution ("we", "our", "us") is a multi-tenant travel agency management platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.
**Account Information:** When you register, we collect your name, email address, phone number, company name, and password.
**Business Data:** Client records, booking details, invoices, payment records, vendor information, and other operational data you enter into the platform.

**Traveler Information:** Passport details, travel documents, and personal information of travelers managed through your agency. This data is stored on behalf of your agency and is your responsibility to collect with proper consent.
**Usage Data:** We automatically collect information about how you interact with the platform, including pages visited, features used, and session duration.
**Payment Information:** Subscription payment details such as transaction IDs and payment method. We do not store full credit card numbers.
We use collected information to:
list: Send transactional notifications (booking confirmations, payment receipts)
Improve platform features and user experience
Ensure platform security and prevent fraud

p: Each agency on our platform operates in a completely isolated workspace. Your business data (clients, bookings, invoices, vendor information) is never accessible to other agencies or tenants on the platform. Super-admin access is limited to platform management and does not include access to your operational data content.
We do not sell your data. We may share information with:
list: **Payment Processors:** SSLCommerz, bKash, or other payment gateways to process subscription payments
**SMS/Email Providers:** To deliver notifications you configure
**Legal Requirements:** When required by law or to protect our rights

p: We implement industry-standard security measures including encrypted connections (HTTPS), secure authentication with hashed passwords, regular backups, and access controls. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

We retain your data as long as your account is active. If you cancel your subscription, your data will be retained for 90 days before permanent deletion. You can request earlier deletion by contacting support.

You have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. You can export most data through the platform's built-in export features. For account deletion or data requests, contact us at support@travelagencyweb.com.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify registered users of significant changes via email. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
By accessing or using Travel Agency Website & Software Solution ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.

The Platform is a multi-tenant software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform for travel agency management. It provides tools for lead management, quotation building, booking operations, invoicing, payment tracking, vendor management, team collaboration, and reporting.

To use the Platform, you must register an account with accurate information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. Each agency operates as a separate tenant with isolated data.

The Platform offers multiple subscription plans with varying features and limits. You will be billed according to your selected plan and billing cycle (monthly or yearly). Prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT) unless otherwise stated.

You may upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. Refunds are not provided for partial billing periods unless required by law.
You agree not to:
list: Use the Platform for any unlawful purpose
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to other tenants' data
Interfere with or disrupt the Platform's infrastructure
Upload malicious code, viruses, or harmful content
Resell access to the Platform without written consent
Use the Platform to store or transmit content that violates any applicable law

p: You retain ownership of all data you enter into the Platform, including client records, booking details, financial data, and documents. We do not claim ownership of your business data. You grant us a limited license to process and store this data solely for the purpose of providing the service.

We strive to maintain 99.9% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Scheduled maintenance will be communicated in advance when possible. We are not liable for any losses resulting from temporary service unavailability.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Platform shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including but not limited to loss of profits, data, business opportunities, or goodwill, arising from your use of the Platform.

Either party may terminate the agreement at any time. You can cancel your subscription from your account settings. We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms. Upon termination, your data will be retained for 90 days before permanent deletion.

We may modify these Terms of Service at any time. Material changes will be communicated via email to registered users. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

userGuide.subtitle: Step-by-step guide for running your travel agency — from first login to payment collection.
userGuide.helpIntro: If you face any issue, contact our support team:

workflow.title: Full agency workflow (step by step)
workflow.subtitle: Use this flow for every customer — enquiry to payment to delivery.

phases.title: A. One-time setup (do once when you start)
steps: Log in at https://app.travelagencyweb.com with your owner account.
Open Administration → Organization — add company name, logo, phone, address (shows on invoice & quotation).
Open Administration → Team — invite staff; assign roles (Sales, Accountant, Manager).
Open Service catalog (Packages & services) — create your tour, Hajj, visa, hotel programs with price.
Optional: Administration → Website — publish packages on your public site.
Optional: CRM → Vendors — add airlines, hotels, visa agents you pay.
Optional: CRM → Agents — add sub-agents with commission %.

phases.title: B. When a customer enquires (CRM)
steps: CRM → Leads → Add Lead — name, phone, destination, budget, travel date.
Set status: New → Contacted → Qualified.
CRM → Follow-ups — set next call date so nothing is missed.
CRM → Clients — create client record when you have confirmed details (passport, email).

phases.title: C. Send a price (Sales — quotation)
steps: Sales → Quotations → New Quotation.
Select client (or pick from lead).
Add line items — or open Service catalog and click Create quotation on a package row.
Set total price, tax, discount → Save.
Print / PDF / share with customer on WhatsApp.
When customer accepts → Convert to Booking (one click).

phases.title: D. Confirm the sale (Sales — booking)
steps: Sales → Bookings → Add Booking (or open converted booking).
Choose booking type: Tour, Flight, Hotel, Visa, Hajj package, Student, Corporate, etc.
Fill destination, travel dates, amount, assign agent if any.
Open booking row → Booking details: add travelers, passport, upload documents.
Update status: Pending → Confirmed → Ticketed → Completed.

phases.title: E. Collect money (Finance)
steps: Finance → Invoices — invoice is created from booking (or add manually).
Send invoice PDF to customer.
Finance → Payments — record each payment (Cash, bKash, Bank).
On invoice → Installments tab — split total into kisti (1st, 2nd, 3rd) if needed.
Finance → Payment reminders — see overdue invoices and due installments; send reminder.
Finance → Accounts — see cash/bank balance and ledger.

phases.title: F. Deliver the service (Operations)
steps: Operations → Service ops desk — visa, ticket, hotel, transport queues by status.
Open each booking → Ops tab — update PNR, visa status, hotel confirmation.
Operations → Documents — all uploaded files in one place.
Operations → Tasks — assign internal to-do to team.
Hajj/Umrah season only: Operations → Hajj/Umrah ops desk — pilgrims, groups, rooming.

phases.title: G. Customer & partner portals (optional)
steps: Customer portal: portal.travelagencyweb.com — client enters their email → magic link → My Bookings, invoice & kisti summary.
Sub-agent portal: same URL — agent email → Commissions wallet (pending/paid).
Supplier portal: vendor email → Purchase orders (payables).

phases.title: H. Monitor the business (daily habit)
steps: Overview → Dashboard — leads, bookings, overdue invoices, quick actions.
Finance → Reports — sales, payments, profit (Business plan).
Administration → Activity log — who changed what (owner/manager).
Bell icon (top bar) — system notifications.

daily-workflow.title: Daily workflow (quick checklist)
daily-workflow.intro: Print this mentally every morning — same order for every agency.
steps: 1. Dashboard — check overdue invoices & follow-ups due today.
2. Follow-ups — call/WhatsApp customers due today.
3. Leads — update status for new enquiries from phone/Facebook.
4. Quotations — send pending quotes.
5. Bookings — confirm new sales; update ops status on open trips.
6. Invoices & Payments — record money received today.
7. Service ops desk — process visa/ticket/hotel queue.
8. Payment reminders — chase overdue kisti before travel date.
tips: Rule: No booking without client record. No payment without invoice.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: See a snapshot of your business at a glance.
steps: Total leads, bookings, invoices and income/expense graphs are shown.
Track recent activity and upcoming tasks.
Click any card to jump to that module.

clients.title: Clients
clients.intro: Store and manage all your client information.
steps: Open Clients page and click "Add Client".
Fill in name, phone, email, passport number, address etc.
Save to add the client to the list.
Click any client name to see full profile, bookings & payment history.
Use Edit/Delete icons to update or remove.
tips: Use the search bar to find clients fast.
Use Export to download all clients as CSV/Excel.

agents.title: Agents
steps: Add a new agent from the Agents page.
Set commission rate for each agent.
View bookings and commission reports per agent.

vendors.title: Vendors / Suppliers
vendors.intro: Maintain supplier records — airlines, hotels, transport companies etc.
steps: Use Add Vendor to add supplier information.
Track payables with each vendor.
View all purchase & payment history from Vendor Details.

leads.title: Leads
leads.intro: Capture and follow up potential customer enquiries.
steps: Add a new enquiry from Add Lead (name, phone, destination, budget).
Update lead status: New → Contacted → Qualified → Converted/Lost.
Add notes and follow-up dates on each lead.
Create a quotation directly from a lead.
tips: Check Pending Follow-up leads every day.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.intro: Assign and track tasks for your team.
steps: Create new task with Add Task.
Set deadline, priority and assignee.
Mark Completed when done.

quotations.title: Quotations
steps: Go to Quotations → New Quotation.
Select client and add service items (flight, hotel, visa etc.).
Set price, tax and discount.
Save then Print/PDF download or email.
Convert to Booking in one click when accepted.

packages.title: Packages & services
packages.intro: Your service catalog — reusable templates for the website and quotations. Not individual customer sales.
steps: Open Packages & services from the sidebar (Catalog group).
Use tabs (Tour, Hajj, Visa, etc.) to filter program types.
Create or edit a template: pricing, itinerary, inclusions, publish status.
Published templates sync to your public website packages page.
Click Create quotation on a row to prefill the quotation builder.
tips: Programs (catalog) vs Bookings (sales) vs Hajj ops desk (pilgrimage seasons) — keep them separate.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.intro: Confirmed customer sales — one booking = one trip or service contract.
steps: Sales → Bookings → Add Booking (or convert from quotation).
Pick type: Tour, Flight, Hotel, Visa, Package (Hajj/Umrah), Student, Manpower, Transport, Corporate.
Use sidebar filters (/bookings/hajj, /bookings/visa, etc.) to focus one category.
Open booking → Details: travelers, timeline, documents, segments.
Link agent for commission; link package for snapshot price.
Statuses: Pending → Confirmed → Ticketed → Traveling → Completed.
tips: Delivery work happens in Booking details + Service ops desk — not in Packages catalog.

operations.title: Service operations desk
operations.intro: Operations team queue for visa, tickets, hotels, transport — without mixing all bookings in one list.
steps: Operations → Service ops desk.
Tabs/desks: Visa, Ticket, Hotel, Transport, Departures.
Open a row → Booking ops panel — update ops status, PNR, embassy, check-in dates.
Filter by pending / in-progress / done.
Student/Manpower agencies: Operations → BD operations desk (if enabled in settings).

finance-desk.title: Finance — installments & reminders
finance-desk.intro: Phase 4 finance tools — kisti plans and overdue chasing.
steps: Finance → Invoices → open invoice → Installments tab → add kisti rows with due dates.
When customer pays, payment auto-allocates to oldest unpaid kisti first.
Finance → Payment reminders — lists overdue invoices + due installments.
Click Send reminder (uses SMS/email if configured; console mode in dev).
Finance → Commissions — agent commission per booking; mark paid when settled.
Finance → Accounts → Expenses tab for office cost; Ledger for full history.

portal.title: Customer & agent portal
portal.intro: Self-service at portal.travelagencyweb.com — separate from staff app.
steps: Customer: must have Client email in CRM → portal login with that email → magic link.
Customer sees: booking list, trip detail, invoice total, kisti status.
Sub-agent: Agent record email → portal → Commissions tab (pending/paid wallet).
Supplier: Vendor email → Purchase orders (amount due to them).
Staff app remains app.travelagencyweb.com — do not confuse the two URLs.
tips: Magic link expires in 15 minutes — ask customer to check spam folder.

follow-ups.title: Follow-ups
follow-ups.intro: Daily call-back list so leads and clients are not forgotten.
steps: CRM → Follow-ups.
See all leads/clients with next follow-up date today or overdue.
After call, update lead status and set next follow-up date.
Convert hot lead to quotation when ready.

documents.title: Documents hub
documents.intro: All files uploaded across bookings and clients in one searchable place.
steps: Operations → Documents.
Browse by booking/client upload.
Upload passport, visa copy, ticket PDF from booking details — they appear here too.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.intro: Create invoices and issue payment receipts for clients.
steps: Invoice generates automatically from booking, or add manually.
Print, Download PDF, or email it.
Record received payments with "Add Payment".
Print receipts from the Receipt page.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.intro: Cash, bank, receivables, payables and expenses — complete accounting.
steps: Add bank/cash accounts from the Cash & Bank Accounts tab.
Payments Received: track client payments.
Vendor Payables: see and pay vendor dues.
Add office expenses in the Expenses tab.
View all transactions in the Ledger tab.
Profit & loss summary in Profitability tab.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: View detailed analytical reports of your business.
steps: Sales Report: sales breakdown.
Payment Report: payment collection.
Profitability Report: P&L.
Vendor Report: vendor-wise spend.
Staff Performance: per-staff performance.
Leads & Quotation Report: conversion rate.
Filter by custom date range and Export.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Log of all email/SMS notifications sent by the system.
steps: View delivery status of each notification.
Check reason on failure and re-send.

hajj.title: Hajj / Umrah ops desk
hajj.intro: Seasonal pilgrimage operations — pilgrims, groups, rooming, and installment payments. Package templates live under Packages & services.
steps: Enable the Hajj/Umrah ops desk in Settings if your agency runs pilgrimage seasons.
Manage pilgrims, groups, visa progress, and payments from the ops desk.
Create Hajj/Umrah program templates under Packages → Hajj or Umrah tabs.
Customer sales remain under Sales → Bookings (Hajj/Umrah filter).
tips: Pure tour agencies can turn the ops desk off — Hajj program templates and bookings still work if needed.

team.title: Team & Roles
team.intro: Add staff and set their access levels.
steps: Use Invite Member on Team page to add new staff.
An invitation email is sent — they set their password.
Create custom roles (e.g. Sales, Accountant, Manager) in Roles.
Set View/Create/Edit/Delete permissions per module.
tips: Owner role has full access — assign carefully.

organization.title: Organization
organization.intro: Your company info — shown on invoices, quotations and website.
steps: Fill company name, logo, address, phone, email, website.
Add Trade License / TIN number.
Set default currency and tax rate.

website.title: Website Customizer
website.intro: Launch a professional travel agency website on your subdomain.
steps: Choose a template (Travel Agency / Tour Packages / Hajj-Umrah).
Customize hero section, colors, logo, content.
Add packages to display on the website.
Connect a custom domain from Admin → Domains.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.intro: Your subscription plan, billing and upgrade.
steps: View current plan and expiry.
Click Upgrade to move to a higher plan (Basic / Pro / Business / Enterprise).
Choose payment method (bKash / SSLCommerz / Card).
Download payment history and invoices.

steps: Profile: update your name and password.
SMTP Settings: send client emails via your own email server.
Data Export: download full data backup.

workflow.title: Super admin process (step by step)
workflow.subtitle: Follow this flow for every new agency signup and subscription payment.
steps: New agency registers → 3-day Pro trial starts automatically (no manual approval needed).
Check Admin → Payment Requests when agency submits bKash/Nagad/bank payment.
Verify transaction ID + amount → Approve → choose plan, billing cycle, Activate now.
Agency refreshes or logs in again → full portal access restored until next expiry.
Before expiry: cron sends reminders. After expiry: agency can log in but sees payment screen only.
To suspend an agency: Subscriptions or Agency detail → Suspend (blocks access immediately).
Configure receiving numbers: Payment Requests → save bKash/Nagad/Rocket/bank details.
Custom domains: Domains → verify DNS → activate SSL for Pro+ agencies.
